package.name: democratic-city
package.author: Renato Fabbri
package.notes:
The Brazilian civil society portal Democratic City (Cidade Democrática) is devoted to social participation and has a long history of activity that includes problems and solutions gathering, the creation of observatories and contests, etc.
This data is a RDF triplification of the portal MySQL tables, to the extent found useful, and includes user data, topics, comments, contests, prizes, tags and tagging, places, neighborhoods, cities, states, links, observatories, inspirations, images. The dump used is from Mar/19/2014.

==
Link to portal: http://cidadedemocratica.org.br

==
Related documents:

(UNDP product) https://github.com/ttm/pnud5/raw/master/latex/produto.pdf

==
This IPython Notebook have with online scripts to analyse this dataset:
http://200.144.255.210:8080/notebooks/cidade%20democr%C3%A1tica%2C%20aa%20e%20participa.ipynb

==
Related OWL Ontologies:

OCD: Cidade Democrática Ontology:
http://vocab.e.gov.br/2014/10/OCD.ttl
(alternate: https://github.com/ttm/ocd/blob/master/OCD.ttl)
http://vocab.e.gov.br/2014/10/OCD.owl
(alternate: https://github.com/ttm/ocd/blob/master/OCD.owl)

OCD is a data driven ontology, built by this script:
https://github.com/ttm/ocd/blob/master/OCD.py

==
This script delivers the present RDF data from the MySQL dump of the Cidade Democrática portal.
https://github.com/ttm/ocd/blob/master/triplificaCD.py

==
Authors are grateful to CNPq (process: 140860/2013-4, project 870336/1997-5), United Nations Development Program (PNUD/ONU, contract: 2013/000566; 
project BRA/12/018), SNAS/SGPR from the Brazilian Presidency, and the Postgraduate Committee of the São Carlos Physics Institute (IFSC/USP).
Authors thank Datahub.io team for hosting the present triplestore.

package.name: dataa
package.author: Renato Fabbri
package.notes:
This dataset gathers messages of ongoing work from AA (Algorithmic Autoregulation) users. Such messages have the purpose of registering
worktime and activity, easing teamwork and resource sharing.
This dataset gathers nicks, messages, sessions, screencast links, rattings,
with appropriate datetime measures. Sources of messages are: MySQL database, MongoDB database and IRC logs from July/2011 to January/2015.

Link to primary source:
https://github.com/ttm/aa01

https://github.com/ttm/aa01/blob/master/rdf/triplificaAAirc.py
https://github.com/ttm/aa01/blob/master/rdf/triplificaAAmongo.py

http://vocab.e.gov.br/2014/09/ontologiaa.owl

(alternative:
https://github.com/ttm/aa01/blob/master/rdf/ontologiaa.owl
https://github.com/ttm/aa01/blob/master/rdf/ontologiaa.ttl
)

==
These are IPython Notebooks with online scripts to analyse this dataset:

http://200.144.255.210:8080/notebooks/aa%20reasoning%20e%20participa.ipynb
